# Tale of two halves leaves Iraola with plenty to ponder

![Image 1: Andoni Iraola shouts instructions at his Liverpool players during a pre-season friendly against Leeds](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/3840/cpsprodpb/366e/live/533fb970-8ec6-11f1-942d-9772a4b2ac54.jpg)Image source, Getty Images

Image caption, 

Liverpool leave their USA pre-season tour with two wins and one defeat

By

[Aadam Patel](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/topics/c9wx1wnyxp5t)

Football reporter,At at Soldier Field in Chicago

*   Published 13 minutes ago 

**On the flight home from Chicago, as he reflects on the 4-2 loss to**[**Leeds**](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/teams/leeds-united)**that ended**[**Liverpool**](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/teams/liverpool)**'s United States tour, manager Andoni Iraola will have plenty to think about.**

The first-half display was arguably the best since the Spaniard took charge, but the second was categorically their worst as they conceded four times without reply inside 25 minutes.

Iraola did make a raft of changes at the break and in the second half but that is no excuse for the way they capitulated against Daniel Farke's side.

Their lack of squad depth and physicality was alarmingly exposed and Iraola will be concerned with the ease with which [Leeds](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/teams/leeds-united) scored, albeit against an inexperienced backline that finished with Calvin Ramsay, Ifeanyi Ndukwe and Mor Talla Ndiaye.

With Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz making their return, [Liverpool](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/teams/liverpool) were excellent in the first half and it is important not to be too critical but perhaps Iraola will be glad in the long-run that he saw this second-half display, where [Liverpool](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/teams/liverpool)'s set-piece deficiencies were evident too.
